scope.review_boundary: Within this B5 red-team scope, only the B5 design and this independent review artifact were edited. Other dirty and untracked paths, including concurrent B1/B4 capability work and the deterministic handoff, were treated as pre-existing/concurrent state, not as B5 authority, and were not reverted or changed by this review. No evaluator, native asset, test implementation, raw run or external service was created.

knowledge_base.binding_interpretation: DR-015 and STR-005 support reserving capacity for route-critical roles while pricing Prize/gust/spread exposure, but remain research-only heuristics. SF-006 is a feature hypothesis, not executable effect semantics. CON-001, CON-002 and CON-004 require route-floor guards, exact local opportunity cost and semantic option permutation controls. Twelve P0/P1 research questions remain open/in review/blocked and three contradictions remain unresolved.

report_only_corrections.finding: The original mechanical-canary wording described two formulation runs with candidate/control arms and 32 total games, which did not satisfy the required exact 24-game one-per-cell staging before screen.
report_only_corrections.correction: Stage 1 now has exactly three arms (B0_CONTROL, B5-A and B5-B) across four anchors x two candidate seats, one game per cell: 3 x 4 x 2 = 24. It is explicitly mechanical-only, with no WDL interval or strength claim.

report_only_corrections.finding: Role, local-delta, Prize, gust and spread receipt shapes did not make all source/target semantics, option binding, qualification authority and asset/deck scope mandatory enough to resist a shape-valid forged receipt.
report_only_corrections.correction: Added exact semantic payload/entity fields, qualification IDs/status allowlists, current observation digests, candidate/anchor scope, native/library/wrapper/card-table hashes, fixture/config/manifest digests, canonical content rules and native-only QUALIFIED_CABT_CAPSULE authority.

report_only_corrections.finding: B5-B's decision-key prose could be read as a lexicographic ordering of liability coordinates after its strict-dominance test, which would silently choose among incomparable vectors.
report_only_corrections.correction: B5-B now uses only a unique strict component-wise dominance relation. Equal, overlapping or incomparable vectors are AMBIGUOUS/B0_DELEGATE; no reviewed dimension order resolves them.

report_only_corrections.finding: The B5-F02 control prose said the options had the same liability even though its stated vectors were X=[1,0,0] and Y=[2,1,1].
report_only_corrections.correction: F02 now states that role terms tie and A's declared later liability tie term selects X; B selects X by strict dominance. This is a control, not a WDL result.

report_only_corrections.finding: The generic F07 expectation said A and B both delegate on missing liability, while A was allowed to use liability only as an optional tie term.
report_only_corrections.correction: The active A preregistration requires complete liability receipts because its declared tie term is enabled. A role-only diagnostic must disable that term explicitly; B always delegates on missing liability. Hidden, successor and prose mutations remain distinct boundary failures for both arms.

report_only_corrections.finding: The design referenced B1-F12 and B2-B4 lineage but did not explicitly prevent double-counting a shared role, Prize/resource, local-delta or threat fact across phases or formulations.
report_only_corrections.correction: Added an overlap_and_double_counting_contract: B1 is lineage-only, B2 receipt IDs are deduplicated, B3 visible-card/Prize/capacity ledger facts are counted once, B4 gust/spread receipts are referenced rather than rescored, B0 is never a feature, and A/B feature sets remain isolated.

report_only_corrections.finding: The original comparison language required a fresh B0 per formulation without distinguishing the requested shared mechanical canary, and its generic interval wording could invite statistical interpretation of one-game cells.
report_only_corrections.correction: The comparison contract now limits the shared B0 exception to Stage 1 mechanical evidence, requires fresh independent B0 strength arms from Stage 2 onward, and explicitly withholds WDL intervals and strength interpretation from Stage 1.

report_only_corrections.finding: The activation denominator was not defined tightly enough to distinguish eligible current bench requests from unsupported or unknown requests, and the one-game canary could be mistaken for an activation gate.
report_only_corrections.correction: Added an exact eligible-request denominator and stated that Stage 1 cannot satisfy the confirmation opportunity rule. Confirmation still requires at least 32 nondelegated decisions overall, 8 per anchor-seat cell and 5 percent activation per eligible cell.

independent_assurance.real_ab_divergence: PASS_BY_DESIGN_REVIEW: B5-F01 has one free slot and both options pass the hard required-role floor. X adds qualified backup-role surplus with liability [2,2,2]; Y adds no optional role surplus with [1,0,0]. A selects X by route-role reserve, while B selects Y because Y strictly dominates X on all three lower-is-safer dimensions. F02 is a no-divergence control: identical role terms and X=[1,0,0] strictly dominates Y=[2,1,1]. No hidden or successor value is needed. This is fixture arithmetic only; no native WDL is claimed.
independent_assurance.public_current_only: PASS_BY_CONTRACT: Inputs are current EngineObservationV1, SelectionRequestV1, visible entities, complete current legal options and exact current receipt fields. Hidden hand/deck/Prize identity, archetype inference, future response, successor observation, counterfactual outcome, probabilities, native private objects, raw option order, card prose and manual randomness are forbidden.
independent_assurance.receipt_specificity: PASS_AFTER_CORRECTIONS: BenchRoleReceiptV1, BenchLocalDeltaV1, PrizeStaticV1, GustExposureV1 and SpreadExposureV1 now require exact observation/entity/option semantics, source/target ownership and zone, scoped asset/deck hashes, content-bound qualification and canonical receipt-manifest digests. Prize, gust and spread values are unknown rather than zero when not qualified.
independent_assurance.boundary_rejection: PASS_BY_CONTRACT: F04 terminal-first, F07 hidden/successor/prose and unknown receipts, F08 nonfinite/malformed numeric values, F09 role conflicts, and F12 unregistered/mismatched/forged/duplicate receipts have distinct reject or B0_DELEGATE outcomes. A forged whole receipt cannot gain authority by preserving labels.
independent_assurance.options_stop_compound_lifecycle: PASS_BY_CONTRACT: Complete current option sets are required; activation is singleton bench/PLAY-to-bench only; ordered and multi-select requests delegate. STOP is a real CompoundActionBuilder token, not a LegalOption row. Terminal-first handling, (episode_uuid, player, policy_id) state isolation, idempotent duplicates, stale rejection, reset boundaries and final G1 validation are explicit. F05/F06/F10/F11 cover mirror, permutation, STOP/compound and lifecycle behavior.
independent_assurance.candidate_seat_statistics: PASS_BY_DESIGN_REVIEW: Primary natural deployment is candidate-perspective WDL over four anchors x two candidate seats. Candidate and B0 strength samples are independent, forced seat is diagnostic only, each eligible candidate game has 32 semantic permutations, per-cell WDL uses game-level bootstrap intervals, candidate-control deltas use 10000 independent resamples, and the aggregate is the fixed equal-cell mean. Confirmation requires zero reliability defects, runtime limits, activation floors, lower 95 percent bound > +0.02, point estimate at least B0 and no cell below B0 by more than 0.10.
independent_assurance.staging: PASS_AFTER_CORRECTIONS: Stage 0 remains fixture-only and blocks native work. Stage 1 is exactly 24 games, one per arm/anchor/seat cell, before Stage 2 local screen. Stage 1 has no strength interpretation; later screens use fresh equal-budget B0 arms and the preregistered 32/8/5 percent opportunity gates.
independent_assurance.provenance_and_self_hash: PASS_AFTER_CORRECTIONS: RuntimeImportAndSourceV1 binds implementation, transitive source, config/schema, deck, engine, wrapper, dependency, fixture and receipt-manifest digests. The reviewed design's final SHA-256 is recorded by this review as a cross-file value; neither report embeds a recursive self-hash placeholder.
independent_assurance.overlap_and_double_counting: PASS_AFTER_CORRECTIONS: B1-F12 is lineage/fixture evidence only; B2 role/local-delta receipts are deduplicated by exact identity and current digest; B3 resource/Prize facts are scoped and counted once; B4 gust/spread receipts are receipt references, not an extra threat score; B5-A and B5-B do not share an added liability/role score; B0 output is never an input.
independent_assurance.native_readiness: BLOCKED: No B5 evaluator, fixture implementation, complete native capability receipts, B0-compatible import manifest or native run exists. The report authorizes no native, Kaggle, production, deck-freeze, training or submission work.

Bind canonical public fixture content and all role/local-delta/Prize/gust/spread receipts, run fresh-process boundary/permutation/mirror/lifecycle/STOP/compound/numeric/forgery tests, and stop before any native canary unless Stage 0 is independently reviewed PASS.
